accepted.text: NS and EW directions must never show yellow or green at the same time because phases are separated by all-red.
Queued vehicles on N can never be negative.
Queued vehicles on E can never be negative.
Queued vehicles on S can never be negative.
Queued vehicles on W can never be negative.
ns_active is the max of N and S signals whose values are at most green (2).
ew_active is the max of E and W signals whose values are at most green (2).
Time waiting in red can never be negative.
A green discharges at most one vehicle per step so the N queue cannot drop by more than one per second.
A green discharges at most one vehicle per step so the E queue cannot drop by more than one per second.
A green discharges at most one vehicle per step so the S queue cannot drop by more than one per second.
A green discharges at most one vehicle per step so the W queue cannot drop by more than one per second.
